description: Get an ad creation job by jobId. Returns the full result and stage progress by default; compact: true returns an ads summary with created, failed and total counts and progress measured in ads. Includes the last 20 progress.operations (operations: "full" returns all retained ones). A job that is still running has complete: false, and compact running jobs include a nextStep hint.

compact.description: Opt in to a compact ads summary. Default false preserves the full result and original stage progress.

operations.description: Use recent for the last 20 operations or full for the complete operation log.

name: ads_get_job
title: Get Job Status
